ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the pressure distribution at several locations on the 31°N latitude line. The horizontal axis marks locations 1—7; the left vertical axis is longitude (E), and the right vertical axis is pressure (hPa). Point 4 in the figure corresponds to a longitude of about 75°E; the pressure curve reaches a low value on this latitude line near point 4, showing a low-pressure center. Reasoning: 75°E, 31°N is located near India in South Asia. Among the world’s major atmospheric activity centers, the low-pressure activity center in South Asia and India is called the Indian Low. Therefore, place 4 in the figure is greatly influenced by the Indian Low.

method.method_draft: 读图确定4号点的大致经度和气压特征：4号点约位于75°E、31°N，且为该纬线上的低压中心。再把该位置与世界主要大气活动中心分布相联系：南亚/印度附近的低压活动中心是印度低压。因此图中4处受印度低压影响较大。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中为北纬31°纬线上若干地点的气压分布示意，横轴标出1—7号地点；左纵轴为经度(E)，右纵轴为气压(hPa)。图中4号点对应的经度约在75°E附近；气压曲线在4号点附近达到该纬线上的低值，表现为低压中心。
推理：75°E、31°N位于南亚印度附近。世界主要大气活动中心中，南亚、印度一带的低压活动中心称为印度低压。因此，图中4处受印度低压影响较大。
